skill.summary: Skip the learning curve of professional editing software. Describe what you want — turn this image into a 5-second video clip without using any credits — and...

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Image to Video No Credits.
- Instantly convert uploaded images (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC up to 200MB) into 5-second video clips without using any credits.
- Automatic backend setup: handles authentication, session creation, and processing on remote GPU nodes.
- Offers export in MP4 and other common formats for easy sharing on social media platforms.
- No installation required; all rendering and editing are performed server-side.
- Users can re-render without consuming extra credits.
